name: Voodoo Feathers
label: Quest
description: Voodoo Feathers: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your honor has brought some peace to me. It is only right that I offer you something in return.
My weapons and armor were splendid in life, and yet they are of no use to me now. They would be better served in your possession.

Travel to the sunken temple and destroy the troll guardians Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. They carry magic feathers that can reform my physical body long enough to grant you a reward.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you back so soon? Time is not the same to me any more, perhaps it has indeed been a long journey for you...

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last I can feel the cold touch of steel again, even if only for a moment.
